buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 2. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 3 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.

5. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 6. Generic End User Certificate: Wherever Bidders are insisting for End User Certificate from the Buyer, same shall be provided in Buyer’s standard format only. 7. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 8. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Compliance with Technical Specifications The offered Smart Target System must fully comply with all technical specifications mentioned in the bid d ocument. Any deviation from the technical specifications shall lead to rejection of the bid. Bidder must submit a deta iled compliance statement against each technical parameter. 2. OEM Authorization Bidder must submit valid OEM Authorization Certificate (MAF) specific to this bid. OEM should confirm availability of spare parts and after-sales support for a minimum period of 05 years. 3. Demonstration & Technical Evaluation The bidder shall provide live demonstration of the offered system at consignee location/trial location if req uired. Failure to demonstrate the system as per QRs/SOR may result in disqualification. Trial and technical evalu ation expenses shall be borne by the bidder. 4. Experience Criteria Bidder/OEM should have prior experience in supply, installation, and commissioning of similar Smart Targe t Systems to Govt/Defence/Paramilitary/Police organizations. Documentary proof of at least 03 successful installations must be submitted. 5. Quality Certification OEM/Bidder must possess valid ISO 9001:2015 / ISO 27001 certification. In-house R&D certification / Government recognized R&D certificate preferred. 6. Warranty Minimum comprehensive onsite warranty of 03 years from the date of successful installation and acceptan ce. During warranty, all repairs/replacements shall be free of cost. 7. Installation & Commissioning Complete installation, integration, testing, and commissioning to be carried out by OEM/authorized representative at consignee location. All accessories, software, cables, connectors, mounts, and peripherals required for full functionality shall b e included.

8. Training Bidder shall provide operational and maintenance training to operators/instructors for minimum 03 days. Training material and user manuals must be supplied. 9. Software Requirements Software should be genuine, licensed, and perpetual. Software must support future upgrades and customization. Software should be free from malware and security vulnerabilities. 10. Security Compliance System should comply with cyber security requirements. Necessary security patches and updates must be provided during warranty. The bidder shall ensure no unauthorized remote access/backdoor exists. 11. Delivery Period Delivery, installation, and commissioning must be completed within time frame from issuance of Supply Or der. 12. Inspection Pre-dispatch inspection may be carried out by buyer/authorized board. Final acceptance shall be based on successful installation and functional testing. 13. Performance Security Successful bidder shall submit Performance Security as per GeM/GoI norms. 14. Penalty Clause Delay in supply/installation beyond stipulated period shall attract LD (Liquidated Damages) as per GeM Rul e. 15. Service Support Bidder must have service support infrastructure in India. Complaint response time should be within 48 hours. 16. Documentation. The bidder shall submit: .Technical brochure/catalogue .Compliance matrix .OEM authorization .Warranty certificate .Installation certificates .User manuals .Test certificates 17. Acceptance Criteria. The system must: .Successfully detect and display shot locations. .Meet accuracy parameters as per QRs. .Operate in all specified modes. .Pass live firing trials. 18. Scope of Supply. Supply should include: .Smart Targets (8 Nos) .Acoustic H-Frame (8 Nos) .Firing Point Equipment (8 Nos) .Master Control Station (1 No) .Software .UPS .Networking components

.Cables and accessories .Installation tools .Training 19. Buyback / Upgradation OEM should support future software and hardware upgrades for at least 5 years. 20. Bid Rejection Criteria. Bid shall be rejected if: .Incomplete documents submitted. .Technical specifications not matched. .False claims/documents found. .Demonstration/trial failed. .Non-submission of OEM authorization. 21. PAYMENT TERMS . Payment shall be released only after successful delivery, installation, commissioning, testing and accepta nce of the complete Smart Target System (8 Lane) by the Buyer/Acceptance Committee. . No advance payment shall normally be admissible. Payment shall be made through GeM as per applicabl e GeM/Government rules. . 100% payment shall be released after: - Complete supply of all equipment and accessories. - Successful installation and commissioning. - Successful demonstration/trial of all 8 lanes. - Verification of technical specifications and quantity. -Submission of required documentation, warranty certificates and installation/commissioning report. - Acceptance of the complete system by the Buyer/Acceptance Committee. 22. ANNUAL MAINTENANCE CONTRACT (AMC) . After expiry of the comprehensive warranty period, the Buyer may enter into an AMC for a further period of 04 years, subject to requirement, satisfactory performance and availability of funds. . AMC shall be comprehensive in nature and shall cover: - Smart Target Units. - Acoustic sensors and H-Frames. - Firing Point Equipment. - Master Control Station. - Networking and communication equipment supplied under the contract. - UPS and associated system components. - Licensed system software. - All supplied accessories/components necessary for operation of the system. .
